differences.text_excerpt: Use the single ink-kite ranger portrait most recently shown as the exact identity reference. Preserve the same lean 2.8-head chibi young man, narrow pointed face, dark half-lidded eyes, straight black high long ponytail, graphite-gray robe, muted jade and ivory lapels, one short shoulder cape, compact folded kite framework on his back, sheathed short sword, tiny red tassel and laced boots. Polished hand-painted HD 2D Daoist RPG sprite art, consistent matte shading. Make ONE 2x2 WALK ANIMATION SHEET, exactly four full-body drawings in TL TR BL BR reading order on perfectly flat solid #FF00FF. Every body faces EAST toward image RIGHT, strict RIGHT PROFILE with nose right and one eye visible. Backward/trailing side is image LEFT. WALK IN PLACE with four visually distinct gait silhouettes: TL first wide stride with camera-near leg straight FORWARD and camera-far leg straight BACK, near hand backward/far hand forward; TR passing pose with legs close and camera-far KNEE bent in FRONT of body, camera-near foot planted flat; BL reverse stride with camera-near leg BACK and camera-far leg FORWARD, near hand forward/far hand back; BR recovery pose with camera-near knee pointing DOWN and boot bent UP BEHIND the buttock, camera-far leg straight planted below pelvis. In BR the raised boot MUST be BEHIND the body, on the trailing side, rather than lifted in front as in TR. Each of all four poses visibly distinct; opposite strides and arm swings. Natural walk with small knee raise, no running or jumping. Same exact camera and orientation, identical head size and anatomical scale in all cells. Each entire body, ponytail, kite and weapon inside central 65-70% of equal invisible cells, generous clear magenta padding, stable planted-sole baseline. No shadow, floor, dust, FX, labels, text, grid lines, borders or watermark. Square output requested 2048x2048.
